Overview

Fuzhou is a city in Fujian with a population of 8,291,000. Capital of Fujian province, a historic port city with hot springs, traditional architecture, and a growing digital economy. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
